items.title: Nakhon Phanom
items.description: Nakhon Phanom is a province in northeastern Thailand, bordering Laos to the east over the Mekong River. It’s known for the huge, ornate Wat Phra That Phanom temple, a significant religious site said to contain the Buddha’s breastbone. The provincial capital, also called Nakhon Phanom, is home to several other temples, including Wat Okat Si Bua Ban, which features 2 sacred golden images of the Buddha. ― Google

Nakhon Phanom is `a peaceful province and border city in northeastern Thailand (Isan), known for the Mekong River, Lao-Vietnamese cultural blends, and sacred shrines` . It sits 736 kilometers northeast of Bangkok and borders Khammouane, Laos, across the river.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nakhon_Phanom_province) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nakhon_Phanom_province)[[2]](https://www.nomadicnotes.com/notes-on-nakhon-phanom/)[[3]](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Nakhon_Phanom)[[4]](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/nakhon-phanom-guide)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nakhon_Phanom)

Key Sights and Landmarks

- **Phaya Sri Satta Nakharat Statue** : A giant, seven-headed golden Naga monument on the Mekong riverfront.
- **Wat Phrathat Phanom** : A famous, highly revered ancient Buddhist stupa located about an hour south of the main town.
- **Ho Chi Minh’s House** : A historical wooden home in Ban Nachok where the Vietnamese leader lived in exile during the 1920s.
- **Saint Anna Nong Saeng Church** : An old, classic French-colonial style Catholic church by the river.[](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/nakhon-phanom-guide) [[1]](https://www.bestpricetravel.com/travel-guide/nakhon-phanom.html)[[2]](https://thailandstartshere.com/2025/08/05/things-to-do-in-nakhon-phanom/)[[3]](https://southeastasiabackpacker.com/destinations/thailand-2/northern-thailand/nakhon-phanom/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gBwnkvnKjEA&vl=en&t=857)[[5]](https://www.trip.com/travel-guide/destination/nakhon-phanom-1447128/)

Culture and Food

- **Mekong Riverfront** : Features a wide, scenic pedestrian and cycle path with open-air views of the limestone karsts in Laos.
- **Local Cuisine** : A unique mix of Isan, Lao, Chinese, and Vietnamese flavors, famous for local breakfast broths, grilled meats, and fresh fish.
- **Third Thai–Lao Friendship Bridge** : Connects Nakhon Phanom to Thakhek in Laos.[](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/nakhon-phanom-guide) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xBcbK6ZZpXk&t=20)
